The ways you spend are now ways to earn with the DIB Consumer Cashback Platinum Card. Whether you’re out shopping for groceries or at home paying bills or even refueling your car, you earn cashback whatever you do, wherever you are.

Get back what you deserve and more every time you spend on your DIB Consumer Card. With no minimum saving cap, simply use your Card at qualified merchants and start saving from day one to maximise your monthly cashback.
Earn Cashback on both Platinum Consumer and Rewards Consumer Cards for a myriad of everyday spends on bill payments, NOL and Salik recharges, refueling, and more.
